meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键发布 npm 包到注册中心
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁地将 npm 包发布到线上。
copy.tagline_en: Publish npm packages to registry with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to publish npm packages.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会变成发布管理器，执行完整的npm发布流程：触发GitHub Actions工作流、验证产物、检查npm版本、发布Discord公告等。它会自动完成从确认版本号到最终确认的所有步骤，但绝不会在发布过程中审查代码或修复问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求发布（publish/release/deploy/npm publish）并指定版本升级类型（patch/minor/major）时触发。若未指定版本类型，Claude会先询问。
howto.what_en: Claude becomes a release manager executing the full npm publish workflow: triggers GitHub Actions, verifies artifacts, checks npm versions, posts Discord announcements, etc. It handles all steps from version confirmation to final confirmation but never reviews code or fixes during publish.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to publish, release, deploy, or npm publish with a valid bump type (patch/minor/major). If no bump type is given, Claude asks.
